title: Manifest Auto-Generation from Observed Diffs
description: When no manifest exists for a (skill, golden) tuple, run the validation once and propose a seeded manifest from the observed diff. Operator reviews and accepts. Bootstraps the manifest set as new skills appear.

requirements.title: Seed-from-diff workflow
requirements.description: On first validation for a (skill, golden) without an existing manifest: persist the observed diff as a proposed-manifest record (paths from diff become allowed_paths, with content rules left open). Surfaces a 'review proposed manifest' action in the UI/CLI.
